title: Creator Of The Best Design Skill Just Unveiled His AI Design Workflow
description:
AI design that doesn't look AI-made comes from a process, not a long prompt. We break down Leon Lin's AI design process, apply it to Claude AI design in Claude Code, show the AI design system we use to catch slop, and run Cook, the skill that loops AI product design until it hits your bar.

What we cover in this video
- Leon Lin's AI design process for AI product design, from the top trending author on GitHub
- Claude AI design built in Claude Code, but works in any coding agent, on Claude, Google Gemini or another model
- Short prompt, strong references: Dribbble and AI tools like Inspo MCP, Awwwards MCP and Agent Browser
- Mockups first, so you can design with AI without burning tokens
- Setting the bar with a number, and our 99% test that landed near 66%
- Giving a Claude design run time for real AI website design quality
- Banning the slop that makes AI web design look AI-made
- AI motion design: get the design right first, then motion design with AI from reference videos
- Feedback with targets, and letting another model judge
- Cook: the AI system design that runs Claude AI website design in rounds until it hits your bar
